title: On-Demand Interpretation for Clinics: OPI, VRI, and AI Explained
summary: Compare on-demand interpretation for clinics across OPI, VRI, and AI, including speed, workflow, devices, patient needs, fallback rules, and what clinics should measure.
body_markdown:
###


On-demand medical interpretation provides real-time language support without scheduling an interpreter in advance. Common remote methods include OPI, VRI, and AI medical interpretation.


###


OPI is audio-only interpretation by phone. VRI connects a human interpreter by video, which adds visual communication but requires a camera, screen, and stable connection.


###


AI medical interpretation provides real-time spoken interpretation without waiting for a human interpreter to connect. Clinics still need a plan for unsupported languages, patient preference, accessibility needs, or unclear communication.


###


There is no single best method for every clinic. A strong workflow usually has one clear first-line option plus an easy fallback based on communication quality, patient preference, language fit, and technical performance.


###


Track time to active interpretation, failed starts, staff use, method changes, patient requests, ad hoc interpreter use, and language-related safety reports.
